description: cambio: Facilities and general terms and conditions is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by cambio Belgium. Contains human-readable data on the facilities of our vehicles. It stipulates the terms and conditions for using cambio. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 2 resources in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-07-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
